results.title: A Month In Minnesota
results.overview: When a federal ICE invasion brought chaos and death to their streets and neighborhoods, an unlikely network of grassroots organizers, local business owners, students, and caregivers stepped forward to act. From a nurse midwife visiting pregnant women who were afraid to leave their homes, to a songleader helping people raise their voices in unified protest, the film showcases a diverse coalition who stood up for their community.

results.title: The Lost Land
results.overview: The Lost Land is a short documentary about an ancient forest that sank beneath the Baltic Sea 12,000 years ago. The film follows Professor Vladas Žulkus and his team as they explore the seabed and study the remains of the trees. Their discoveries help us understand the past and reveal how climate change could reshape our coastline in the future.

results.title: Voy Boys
results.overview: At the 2024 National Blind Football Championship, China’s youngest team of all time stepped onto the field — the Xinjiang Blind Football Team, with an average age of 15.

results.title: Testing Testing Sandi Bachom
results.overview: An unlikely citizen journalist finds redemption on the frontlines documenting white supremacy and domestic terrorism in the United States, beginning with Charlottesville.

results.title: Espresso
results.overview: Set in LA 2015, we follow the rise of an actor, Andrew Thompson, during a chemistry read for an upcoming superhero movie, while falling in love in the process with his soon-to-be co-star.

results.title: Redemption River
results.overview: Stranded after a rafting accident, a couple on the brink of collapse must come together to escape the unforgiving wilderness.

results.title: Opt Out
results.overview: Four friends from a long-buried crime are brought back together by a coded text, only to learn that the secret they thought was safe has come unraveled.

results.title: Nachts in der Provinz
results.overview: Richard runs a sausage stand at the local sports ground. When a young woman appears, searching for her runaway horse, he is pulled out of his familiar routine. Together, they set off to find it – and an unusual night begins. Elsewhere, as dusk falls, Anna faces a different kind of departure. After one final shift as a pizza delivery driver, she plans to leave her home village for good. But old relationships, village stories and a ghostly encounter make her wonder whether leaving is really that simple.

results.title: Title
results.overview: An episodic structure links scenes, each with its own internal narrative and logic. In dialogue with John Baldessari’s film ‘Title’

results.title: have you seen me?
results.overview: After his beloved cat disappears amidst a global pandemic, a lonely man turns to his neighbor for help. As isolation takes hold, their search becomes a surreal descent into loneliness, longing, and dimensional dissolution.

results.title: Demontage
results.overview: On the outskirts of Lüdenscheid in Germany, Sandra runs her late father's car recycling business. It is a place where discarded car parts find new owners, and where people find work, structure and a sense of belonging. Together with her employees Holger, Markus and Kevin, who would struggle to find work elsewhere, Sandra has created a fragile utopia. However, a growing chain of external pressures threatens not only the business, but also the lives that are intertwined with it.

results.title: The Dream Synopsis
results.overview: Harrison wakes up from a dream about his friend, Danny, that he desperately wants to forget. His partner, Kennedy, forces him to remember.

results.title: Noir et Blanc
results.overview: After a month of hiding, Detective M has been called by a police chief to investigate the murder, not knowing if he’s in on it or not.

results.title: The Disenchantment
results.overview: In a remote village in the Pyrenees, Inés discovers that the relocation of an ancient church is only the beginning of an immersion into a magical and ancestral world that will change her perception of life and death.

results.title: Red Screen
results.overview: A young and ambitious female profiler is trying to interrogate a maniac about his last victim, who might still be alive. However, the serial killer remains unresponsive. The only way to make him talk is to expose him to an effective yet deadly development called "Red Screen." There's just one problem-the profiler has to be the first one to experience "Red Screen".

results.title: Vespers
results.overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

results.title: Quick Fix
results.overview: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

results.title: Sandy
results.overview: When an Indian teen is inadvertently outed in school, he must face school gossip, his parents' reaction, and his own self-doubt to rebuild an identity on his own terms.

results.title: Sin Lives Upstairs
results.overview: In a Portuguese apartment building, two couples share the same structure, yet live in entirely different universes. Iara and Lusa, a Brazilian couple, face the silence and strain of a marriage marked by routine and an emotional distance from each other and their homeland. Upstairs, Pedro and Inês, a younger Portuguese couple, lead an intense relationship fueled by energy, impulsivity, and a still-vibrant intimacy. Between thin walls, sharp banter, and cultural misunderstandings, their co-existence becomes a stage for laughter, unease, and unexpected revelations.
